notes: Any costs found on the pages are institution-wide (not specific to this programme): the 'instellingscollegegeld' amounts on https://www.inholland.nl/inschrijven/collegegeld/ are general Inholland figures and cannot be tied to the non-EU fee for Bouwkunde, so tuition is left out. The 4-year duration and Dutch language come from the programme's own page. The English-language entry requirements pages supplied (Tourism Management, Creative Business) are pages of other programmes and do not apply to Bouwkunde, so no language-proficiency requirement was extracted for it.

note.en: Check whether your Moroccan diploma (Baccalauréat) is accepted: international diplomas need to be evaluated individually by Inholland's Admissions department.

evidence.quote: All internationally obtained diplomas need to be evaluated by our Admissions department.
